rules.fidelity: weight matched on both systems / total weight
rules.stability: a capability counts as matched only after 3 consecutive matching full runs
rules.zero: missing, skipped, redacted or flaky cases score zero
rules.frozen: entries and weights may not change after measurement starts; add a new version instead
rules.target: fidelity >= 0.90 and coverage >= 0.95 on fixtures/windows/mini-erp, stable over 3 full runs

capabilities.name: Master data: create, edit, list, delete-protect (customers, items)
capabilities.proof: Create customer and item; edit name; deleting a customer used on an invoice is refused with a message.

capabilities.name: Lookups and combo boxes bound to other tables
capabilities.proof: Invoice customer combo lists saved customers; line item combo fills price and tax rate.

capabilities.name: Field validation: required, min/max, formats, uniqueness, cross-field
capabilities.proof: Empty code, duplicate code, bad GSTIN format, negative price, credit limit exceeded each give their message.

capabilities.name: Document numbering per type and year
capabilities.proof: Saving drafts gives INV-2026-0001, INV-2026-0002; numbers are not reused after cancel.

capabilities.name: Header + line documents with add/edit/remove lines
capabilities.proof: Invoice with three lines; edit qty on one; remove one; saved lines match.

capabilities.name: Line maths: qty x price, line and document discount, tax, rounding, totals
capabilities.proof: Known invoice gives exact subtotal, discount, tax per rate and grand total, rounded half-up to 2 decimals.

capabilities.name: Status flow draft -> confirmed -> posted -> cancelled with forbidden transitions
capabilities.proof: Draft can be confirmed and posted; posted cannot be edited; cancelling a posted invoice reverses its effects.

capabilities.name: Stock on hand, movements per document, negative-stock rule
capabilities.proof: Posting reduces stock by line qty; posting beyond stock is refused; cancel restores stock.

capabilities.name: Double-entry postings and ledger balances
capabilities.proof: Posting writes Receivable debit = Sales credit + Tax credit; ledger report balances to zero.

capabilities.name: Lists: search, filter, sort, paging, columns
capabilities.proof: Invoice list search by customer, status filter, sort by total, page 2 of results.

capabilities.name: On-screen report with grouping and totals
capabilities.proof: Sales by customer report shows one row per customer and a grand total equal to posted invoices.

capabilities.name: Print to PDF and CSV export with the same fields and totals
capabilities.proof: Invoice PDF text and list CSV contain the same numbers as the screen.

capabilities.name: Users, roles and permissions per action
capabilities.proof: Clerk can create drafts but cannot post or close a period; admin can.

capabilities.name: Audit trail of changes
capabilities.proof: Each save, post and cancel writes user, time, action and document to the audit log.

capabilities.name: Dates, fiscal periods and period lock
capabilities.proof: After closing a month, posting an invoice dated in it is refused.

capabilities.name: Company or branch selection at login
capabilities.proof: Data entered under one company is not visible under the other.

capabilities.name: Menus, toolbar, tabs, shortcuts and confirmation dialogs
capabilities.proof: Every screen reachable by menu and toolbar; Ctrl+S saves; delete asks for confirmation.

capabilities.name: Same screen layout: positions, sizes, order, grouping, grid columns
capabilities.proof: scripts/layout.py compare scores each screen 90% or more.

capabilities.name: CSV import of master data
capabilities.proof: Importing a customer CSV adds valid rows and reports rejected rows with reasons.

capabilities.name: Error and confirmation messages: same text, place and moment
capabilities.proof: Each validation and confirmation message matches the source word for word.
